title: Instrument Hub sampler kit
description: A drum-kit definition. Each pad is addressed by MIDI note and carries velocity layers; a layer's roundRobin array holds alternate samples that consecutive hits rotate through. Every pad must cover velocities 1..127 exactly once across its layers; overlapping or missing ranges are rejected by KitLoader even though JSON Schema cannot express that rule. Sample paths are absolute or relative to the kit file's directory, and may not contain '..' segments.

schemaVersion.description: Document format version. Only version 1 is accepted.

pads.description: Pads, one per MIDI note. Pad order is not significant; the note decides what is reachable.

note.description: MIDI note that triggers this pad.

gain.description: Linear pad gain, multiplied by the chosen sample's gain.

pan.description: Pad pan added to the chosen sample's pan, clamped to -1..1. -1 is hard left, +1 hard right.

tune.description: Pad tuning in semitones, added to the chosen sample's tuning. Positive is higher.

layers.description: Velocity layers. Ranges must be contiguous and cover 1..127 without overlapping. They may be listed in any order.

minVelocity.description: Lowest MIDI velocity in this layer, inclusive.

maxVelocity.description: Highest MIDI velocity in this layer, inclusive.

roundRobin.description: Alternate samples for this layer. Consecutive hits rotate through them in order; one entry is a fixed sample.

path.description: Absolute path, or a path relative to the kit file's directory. '..' segments are rejected.

gain.description: Linear sample gain, multiplied by the pad gain.

pan.description: Sample pan added to the pad pan, clamped to -1..1.

tune.description: Sample tuning in semitones, added to the pad tuning.
